reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis that a surface oxide layer governs creep resistance in a bulk FCC/BCC HEA coating is physically questionable, as creep is a volume deformation mechanism and a thin surface oxide is unlikely to significantly hinder dislocation motion or grain boundary sliding in the bulk.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares a coated substrate to an uncoated substrate, which changes the material system entirely and does not isolate the effect of the oxide layer on the HEA coating itself, making the test poorly designed to falsify the stated hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it misidentifies the governing factor for bulk creep resistance and proposes a test that would not provide meaningful insight into the creep mechanisms of the HEA coating.
